_about: VST, 2026-09-28 ~02:30 UTC (the evening of 09-27 ET): the Secular Compounder chat (cmukmqjpv000004jn9yp2c1l0) asked update_thesis for a review above $145 — a wake at the 50-day reclaim, no buy while the score is under 7. It was refused 5 times as a half plan (missing_enter_trigger); this is the first call and its answer, verbatim. VST then carried only its 30-day review cadence (added 09-23; the plan came off 09-11 and 09-15). Built read-only.

args.rationale: VST is in a DOWNTREND (Trend Template 0/8), at only 4.4% above its 52-week low of $132.66, RSI 42, and deeply underperforming SPY (-21% over 3 months, -29% over 6 months). The composite scores 5/10 — well below the 7/10 minimum needed for a trade to be approved. The thesis note correctly says "no buy trigger" but the scoring problem is more fundamental: even if I arm a buy level, the 5/10 composite means the system will refuse the trade when it fires. There is no level I can name that changes the score to 7+ without the business confirming. The honest entry condition is a reclaim of the 52-week low zone and a beginning of trend template repair — specifically, price closing back above $145 (the falling 50-day) with composite improving to 7+. Arming a conditional wake instead of a mechanical buy trigger. The ENTER trigger previously missing is now set as a PRICE_ABOVE at $145 — a reclaim of the 50-day breakdown level. This is NOT a buy order; it wakes a tactical review to re-score. The 52-week low at $132.66 remains the hard invalidation (if it breaks on volume with a business update, the thesis is retired). No target or stop set until the score repairs — consistent with the mandate's rule that MEDIUM conviction at 5/10 does not support a priced position.

add_triggers.rationale: Reclaim of the falling 50-day (~$145-146 zone) would be the first Trend Template repair signal and the earliest point at which a buy trigger could be armed. Review to re-score; do not buy automatically until composite reaches 7+.

answer.summary: Refused update on $VST — the resulting plan is invalid (missing_enter_trigger).
answer.message: This thesis carries a plan level (a floor or a target) with no buy level to reach it from. Either finish the plan — set entry_price (the level the buy trigger fires on) — or remove the floor and target triggers and keep the name in view without a plan.
